# Bootstrap Icons

`../../images/tools.svg` contains the [`tools`](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/icons/tools/)
icon from Bootstrap Icons 1.13.1. It is used for both the header logo and favicon.

Upstream: https://github.com/twbs/icons/tree/v1.13.1
Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.13.1/icons/tools.svg
License: MIT; see LICENSE.

The icon's `16 × 16` path is scaled by 5 and centred in a square `128 × 128`
viewBox. A white rounded background keeps the favicon visible on both light and
dark browser tabs.
